notes.title: Preview of future updates and upcoming plans for the game
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we'd like to share with you the goals of the upcoming update

[b]Socialization is strengthened, and the number of players online is retained[/b]
The main problem with the current version of the game is that the number of people online is too small, and it is even said that the game itself has not sold many copies, but we still will not give up the development of the game, at present, the focus of our studio is on how to retain players and let players play online for a long time, we found that the average player did not continue the game after playing for half an hour, or even dozens of minutes, we admit that we do have very little content, However, until this update arrives, we intend to work on new content to increase player online rates (including but not limited to the quest system, etc.)
Speaking of players online, if players can socialize frequently, then the number of people online will increase, so we plan to add a level system, when the level can be upgraded by completing tasks or completing challenges through the map, and we also plan to add a player social panel, where players can display various achievements and unlocked rare badges, etc

[b]Quest system[/b]
Quest systemWe intend to allow players to complete various tasks on the map, such as exploring specific areas, finding specific items, using specific items, etc
The player's character can be accessed and viewed through the main menu and mobile panel.

These are our plans for the near future, but please refer to the update announcement
In addition, our studio is currently in financial difficulty, but because most of our employees work on a voluntary basis, it is not to the point of going out of business
The only impact is that we can't maintain normal work, we may need to take up development time and do temporary work to maintain a normal life, so the update may be late, I hope players forgive us


--------------Tactical Penguin Studio Yours sincerely！

notes.title: 1.22.2 Update!
notes.content:
Our games have always been based on realism
At the same time, it is necessary to make adjustments about the player experience.
In this update, we installed a realistic physiological system to make the game more realistic.
The following is the update.

[b]Fatigue system renewal[/b]
Players will be tired from running too much.
After the fatigue effect is triggered, the player's recovery speed will slow down and his heart rate and blood oxygen will also be affected.

[b]Blood oxygen mechanism addition[/b]
If the blood oxygen is too low in the game, it will lead to a decrease in the recovery health.
There are many mechanisms that affect blood oxygen, including but not limited to running and eating high-energy foods.

[b]Dynamic display of secondary physiological values[/b]
Now the value of the secondary biological sign of the player's medical panel will be displayed normally.
Players can use these values to judge whether your character is normal or not.

[b]Cause of death shows[/b]
After the player dies in the game, you don't need to find someone else to do an autopsy for you!
After the player dies, your cause of death will be displayed in the death panel.
Of course, he will only show the specific cause of death and will not tell you what caused the death.

The above is the specific content of this update.
Our update direction during this period is mainly based on simulation.
All kinds of behaviors of players in the game may influence the characters manipulated in the game.
To give players a more immersive and realistic experience.

notes.title: The official version of 1.0 is here!
notes.content:
After two months of alpha and beta testing, the official version of 1.0 arrived as scheduled.
Compared with the beta version, there are very few bugs in the official version, and some optimization adjustments have been made to greatly improve the player's game experience.
The only pity is that some functions have not been installed because of time, and these functions will come one by one with the version update.
Next is the update of 1.0.

[u]Deke nature reserve Extend[/u]
Deke Nature Reserve Ushered in its first expansion. A new building [logging yard transfer station] has been added to this expansion
And the adjustment of the surrounding environment.
And monsters that have not been installed before have also joined Deke nature reserve.

[u]Deke nature reserve Story update[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/1142c18eeab0ff972f49b105edb2f3b6999cdd74.png[/img]
The regional story of Deke nature reserve has been added, and players can find the story task items in the game to understand the story behind Deke nature reserve.

[u]Production system installation[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/c0a5b09ba494bc31b69f57a734ed82a4683edcf4.png[/img]
Are you still worried that there is no warm bonfire in the wild? Don't worry now!
The production system has been installed, and players can find production materials on the map to make corresponding items.
Although there are very few things that can be made at present, it is definitely a good start, and we will continue to improve it in future updates.

[u]Navigation system update[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971398/debdcc535a46621a96355895bf94be27b8877cae.png[/img]
We improved the existing navigation system to make it more like real navigation software.
And the UI has also been renovated.
In order to facilitate players to meet, we allow players to see each other on the navigation system.

[u]Mental state system installation[/u]
The mental state system has been installed, and the player's reason will decline if he stays in the dark for a long time or touches monsters.
When the player's mental state drops to collapse, it will have negative effects, such as blurred vision and easier to be targeted.
So how do you restore your mental state? You may need the company of many people or a warm bonfire to comfort your broken heart.

The above is the main update content of this 1.0
Let's not talk about the rest of the scattered content and bug fixes.
We have been trying to update and maintain our games.
Thank you for your continuous support.

notes.title: Beta beta is ready to come!
notes.content:
[b]What is Beta?[/b]
Beta is the closest form of our game to the full version.
The various mechanisms in the game will be the same as the official version.
The only difference is that his content will be much less than the official version.

[b]What's the difference between Beta and Alpha beta?[/b]
Alpha beta is actually prepared to test some basic judgments in the game (such as game victory system and backpack system)
It will be very different from the official version, and the UI is also prepared temporarily, so it will be very different from the official version.
And because it is prepared for testing some basic judgments in the game, the game content is not rich.
The Beta version is different. It has the same mechanism as the official version and the same UI as the official version (there may be some minor adjustments, but that's probably it).

[b]Why is there a Beta?[/b]
Bugs are always everywhere, and we must find them before the official version appears, so there will be a Beta version.

[b]What will be updated in Beta?[/b]
We renovated the medical system and made it more realistic.
And the backpack system will also be adjusted.
A new mobile phone system has been added, and you can use the software on your mobile phone, such as navigation and so on.
Then there are many new props.
The most exciting thing is that we will add a new map to him.

[b]When does the Beta start? How long will it last?[/b]
We plan to cover the Beta in the next few weeks. Of course, we will first select some players for internal Beta testing in advance.
If the Beta version works well, it may last for 2-3 months and then the official version will be released.

That's some information about the Beta.
If you want to know more, you can go to Discord or YouTuBe
We will release a pilot trailer in the near future
We also hope that players can promote our games more.
